goal: Asset exposure review: which systems are reachable from outside and which hold sensitive data.
use: Asset exposure review: which systems are reachable from outside and which hold sensitive data. Use when findings need priorities that reflect where systems sit.

steps.note: List the assets. Each system, its owner and its data class.
Check reachability. Note which assets are reachable from the internet.
Check data. Note which assets hold regulated or sensitive data.
Combine. Rank exposure by reachability and data class.
Report. The assets, their exposure and the priority each finding should get.
